paragraphs.en: A concrete mixing plant (batching plant) produces mixed concrete. A concrete pump then places that mix through a pipeline. The pumping side still needs a matching concrete pump manufacturer.

paragraphs.en: If a site plant produces 30 m³/h, the pump’s theoretical delivery should not be far below that figure or the pour will stall. If the plant is small, a compact transfer pump or HBT30-class model may be enough. Always compare the pump table — delivery capacity, horizontal distance, vertical height and aggregate size — not a marketing slogan.
paragraphs.zh: 若现场搅拌约 30 m³/h，泵的理论输送量不应远低于该值，否则浇筑会中断。搅拌规模较小时，紧凑输送泵或 HBT30 级别可能足够。务必对照泵的参数表——输送量、水平距离、垂直高度与骨料粒径——而不是营销口号。

bullets.en: Small pours / secondary structure: transfer pumps and compact HBT models.
bullets.zh: 小方量 / 二次结构：输送泵与紧凑 HBT 机型。

bullets.en: Higher output or longer lines: HBT80-18-140, LL60-75, HBTT55-50.
bullets.zh: 更高产量或更长管路：HBT80-18-140、LL60-75、HBTT55-50。

paragraphs.en: A mobile batching plant moves with the project; a trailer concrete pump also moves, but it does not batch. Contractors who already have a mixer or ready-mix supply only need the pump. Contractors building a new batching line should source the plant from a mixing-plant maker and source the pump from a pump manufacturer such as Pinjin.
paragraphs.zh: 移动搅拌站随项目转移；拖式混凝土泵也会转移，但不负责搅拌。已有搅拌机或商砼供应的承包商只需要泵。新建搅拌线的承包商应从搅拌站厂家采购搅拌设备，并从品锦这样的泵厂家采购混凝土泵。

paragraphs.en: Send plant output, pipeline length, height and aggregate size. The Xingtai engineering team will map the job onto a listed concrete pump. OEM customization is available after specifications are confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 请提供搅拌产量、管长、高差与骨料粒径。邢台工程团队会把工况对应到已列混凝土泵。确认规格后可进行 OEM 定制。

paragraphs.en: Chinese source manufacturers can adjust specifications after confirmation because welding, machining and assembly happen in the same plant. That is why factory-direct OEM is faster than a long reseller chain — provided the change stays inside published, manufacturable parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 中国源头厂家在确认规格后能够调整参数，是因为焊接、机加工与装配在同一工厂完成。所以工厂直供 OEM 比多层转销更快——前提是变更仍在已公布、可制造的参数范围内。

seoTitle.en: Dry Mix vs Wet Mix Spraying Machine | Pinjin Machinery
seoTitle.zh: 干喷与湿喷喷涂机对比 | 品锦机械

description.en: Dry-mix and wet-mix spraying are different ways to place mortar or shotcrete. Choose from Pinjin spraying machines using published pressure, flow and distance.
description.zh: 干喷与湿喷是不同的砂浆或喷浆方式。应按品锦喷涂机已公布的压力、流量与距离选型。

paragraphs.en: In wet-mix spraying, water is already in the mix before it enters the machine. The equipment pumps or screws a plastic mix to the nozzle. Wet-mix is common for mortar finishing and for many construction spraying jobs because dust is lower and the water/cement ratio is easier to control on site.
paragraphs.zh: 湿喷是指拌合物在进入设备前已经加水。设备把塑性拌合物泵送或螺杆输送到喷头。饰面砂浆和许多建筑喷涂常用湿喷，因为粉尘较低，现场也更容易控制水灰比。

imageAlt.en: Machinery assembly area at Hebei Pinjin Machinery factory in Xingjiawan China
imageAlt.zh: 中国邢家湾品锦机械工厂设备装配区

paragraphs.en: In dry-mix spraying, dry material is conveyed and water is added at the nozzle. It can be useful for certain lining jobs, but it needs trained nozzlemen and dust control. Pinjin product pages describe the listed spraying machines by pressure, flow and distance rather than by marketing labels such as “mining dry-mix unit”.
paragraphs.zh: 干喷是干料输送、在喷头处加水。某些护面作业会用到，但需要熟练喷射手与粉尘控制。品锦产品页按压力、流量与距离描述已列喷涂机，而不是用“矿山干喷机组”这类营销标签。

heading.en: How to choose from the catalogue

paragraphs.en: Match the material and the published parameters. Mortar and plaster models are finishing machines. Concrete spraying and plunger machines are closer to structural spray. If the project specification says dry-mix or wet-mix, send that requirement with the output and distance so the factory can confirm a listed model — not an undocumented special.
paragraphs.zh: 对照材料与已公布参数。砂浆与石膏机型用于饰面；混凝土喷浆与柱塞机型更接近结构喷浆。若项目写明干喷或湿喷，请连同产量与距离发给工厂，以便确认已列机型，而不是未公开的特制设备。

description.en: How concrete spraying machines are used for mortar, plaster and shotcrete-style placement. Catalogue spraying equipment from a Xingtai manufacturer.

heading.en: What is a concrete spraying machine?

paragraphs.en: A concrete spraying machine is construction equipment that conveys mortar or concrete mix and sprays it onto a surface. On finishing jobs this is often mortar or plaster spraying. On structural lining jobs the same family of machines is discussed as shotcrete equipment, provided the mix, nozzle and published pressure/flow match the work.

Do not select a trailer pump when the job is wall spraying, and do not select a spraying machine when the job is pipeline placement over hundreds of metres.

label.en: How to choose a concrete pump for construction projects
label.zh: 如何为工程项目选择混凝土泵

title.en: Trailer Concrete Pump vs Truck-Mounted Pump
title.zh: 拖式混凝土泵与车载泵对比

seoTitle.en: Trailer Concrete Pump vs Truck-Mounted Pump | Pinjin Machinery
seoTitle.zh: 拖式混凝土泵与车载泵对比 | 品锦机械

description.en: Compare trailer / transfer concrete pumps with truck-mounted boom pumps. Pinjin’s catalogue lists trailer and transfer pumps manufactured in Xingtai, China.
description.zh: 对比拖式/输送泵与车载臂架泵。品锦目录列出在中国邢台制造的拖式与输送泵。

heading.en: What is a trailer concrete pump?

paragraphs.en: A trailer concrete pump is construction equipment that receives mixed concrete and pushes it through a pipeline to the pour location. It is usually towed or moved on site rather than carrying a folding boom on a truck chassis. Transfer pumps in the same family are compact machines used for shorter secondary-structure or fine-stone placement.
paragraphs.zh: 拖式混凝土泵是接收已拌混凝土并通过管道压送到浇筑点的施工设备。它通常在现场拖行或移位，而不是在汽车底盘上携带折叠臂架。同系列的输送泵更紧凑，用于较短的二次结构或细石浇筑。

paragraphs.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a concrete pump manufacturer in Xingtai, Hebei, China. Catalogue models such as HBT, LL, HBTT and compact transfer pumps publish theoretical delivery capacity, conveying distance and aggregate diameter. Those tables are the basis for selection.
paragraphs.zh: 河北品锦机械制造有限公司是中国河北邢台的混凝土泵厂家。HBT、LL、HBTT 及紧凑输送泵等目录机型公布理论输送量、输送距离与骨料粒径。选型应以这些参数表为依据。

imageAlt.en: Concrete pump manufacturing at Hebei Pinjin Machinery factory in Xingjiawan China
imageAlt.zh: 中国邢家湾品锦机械工厂的混凝土泵制造现场

paragraphs.en: A truck-mounted boom pump combines a truck chassis with a hydraulic boom. It is useful when the site needs rapid relocation and aerial placement without assembling a long pipeline. It also costs more to purchase, license and maintain, and it needs suitable road access.
paragraphs.zh: 车载臂架泵把汽车底盘与液压臂架结合在一起。当现场需要快速移位、且不想铺设长管路时，臂架浇筑很方便。购置、牌照与维护成本也更高，并需要合适的道路条件。

paragraphs.en: Pinjin does not list truck-mounted boom pumps in the current catalogue. Buyers comparing pump types should treat boom trucks as a different equipment class, then decide whether a trailer or transfer pump from a China concrete pump factory meets the pipeline length and output of the job.
paragraphs.zh: 品锦当前目录未列出车载臂架泵。对比泵型时，应把臂架车视为另一类设备，再判断中国混凝土泵工厂的拖式或输送泵是否满足该工程的管长与产量。

heading.en: When a trailer pump is the better match

paragraphs.en: Trailer pumps suit building construction and infrastructure pours where a pipeline can be laid, the machine can stay in one pumping position, and the buyer wants published conveying distance rather than boom reach. They are also easier to match for OEM customization of power type and capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 当可以铺设管路、设备可固定在一个泵送位置、采购需要的是已公布输送距离而不是臂架幅度时，拖式泵更适合建筑与基建浇筑。动力形式与产能也更容易按 OEM 定制对照。

bullets.en: Long horizontal lines: compare HBT80-18-140 and LL60-75 tables.
bullets.zh: 较长水平管路：对照 HBT80-18-140 与 LL60-75 参数表。

bullets.en: Compact site or secondary structure: review transfer pump pages.
bullets.zh: 紧凑场地或二次结构：查看输送泵产品页。

bullets.en: Need factory photos: open the Xingtai factory capability page.
bullets.zh: 需要工厂照片：打开邢台工厂能力页。

paragraphs.en: Send the model name, one-way pipeline length, height difference, target output and aggregate size to the engineering team. After specifications are confirmed against a listed trailer or transfer pump, customized production can be arranged quickly where the catalogue supports it.
paragraphs.zh: 把型号、单程管长、高差、目标产量与骨料粒径发给工程团队。对照已列拖式或输送泵确认规格后，可在目录支持范围内尽快安排定制生产。

title.en: Concrete Pump Maintenance Guide
title.zh: 混凝土泵维护指南

description.en: Practical maintenance checks for hopper, pipeline and wear parts on concrete pumps from a China factory — without undocumented service-hour claims.
description.zh: 针对中国工厂混凝土泵料斗、管路与易损件的实用维护检查，不编造未公布的保养小时数。

heading.en: Clean the hopper and pipeline after use
heading.zh: 使用后清理料斗与管路

paragraphs.en: Leftover mix that hardens in the hopper or pipeline is a common cause of blocked conveying. Flush according to the mix type and the hose or pipe diameter used on site. This guide does not replace the operating instructions supplied with a specific machine.
paragraphs.zh: 料斗或管路中残留拌合物硬化，是堵塞的常见原因。应按现场拌合物类型与管径冲洗。本指南不能替代随机提供的操作说明。

heading.en: Watch wear parts, not marketing intervals
heading.zh: 关注易损件，而不是宣传保养周期

paragraphs.en: Seals, cutting rings, pipes and hopper grate parts wear at different rates depending on aggregate and daily output. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a single service-hour number that fits every project. Inspect parts against the catalogue model you purchased, then ask the factory which replacements match that model.
paragraphs.zh: 密封、切割环、管道与料斗格栅的磨损速度取决于骨料与日产量。河北品锦机械不公布适用于所有项目的单一保养小时数。请按所购目录机型检查零件，再向工厂确认对应易损件。

bullets.en: Check pipeline joints before a long pour
bullets.zh: 长距离浇筑前检查管路接头

bullets.en: Keep the hopper grate in place during feeding
bullets.zh: 上料时保持料斗格栅就位

bullets.en: Record the model name when ordering spare parts
bullets.zh: 订购备件时写明型号名称

paragraphs.en: Diesel and electric pumps need different site support. Unstable voltage or poor fuel quality can stop a pour even when the pumping unit is in good condition. Match power type on the product page before blaming the pump for downtime.
paragraphs.zh: 柴油泵与电机泵需要不同的现场保障。电压不稳或燃油质量差，即使泵送单元状态正常也可能中断浇筑。停机前先核对产品页上的动力形式。

paragraphs.en: If wear is faster than expected, send the model name, conveying distance and aggregate size to the engineering team. description.en: A plain-language explanation of hopper, pumping unit and pipeline on trailer and transfer pumps built by a concrete pump manufacturer in China.
description.zh: 用通俗语言说明中国混凝土泵厂家拖车泵与输送泵的料斗、泵送单元与管路工作方式。

heading.en: Three parts that move the mix
heading.zh: 推动拌合物的三个部分

paragraphs.en: A concrete pump does not “spray” concrete by itself. Catalogue trailer pumps and transfer pumps move a mix from a hopper, through a pumping unit, into a pipeline that reaches the pour point. Matching those three parts to site distance and aggregate size is more useful than comparing model names alone.
paragraphs.zh: 混凝土泵本身不是喷浆设备。目录中的拖车泵与输送泵把拌合物从料斗经泵送单元送入管路，到达浇筑点。把这三部分与现场距离、骨料粒径对应起来，比只比较型号名称更有用。

paragraphs.en: The hopper receives mixed concrete or mortar. If feeding is uneven or the mix is too dry for the listed aggregate diameter, the pumping unit cannot keep a stable flow. Pinjin product pages list maximum aggregate diameter so buyers can check this before inquiry.
paragraphs.zh: 料斗接收已搅拌的混凝土或砂浆。若上料不均匀，或拌合物相对目录列出的骨料粒径过干，泵送单元难以保持稳定流量。品锦产品页列出最大骨料粒径，便于询盘前核对。

paragraphs.en: The pumping unit creates the pressure that pushes the mix through pipes or hoses. Horizontal conveying distance and vertical conveying height on each Pinjin model are catalogue maxima, not a guarantee for every pipeline layout. Long, high or sharply bent lines need a model with enough listed capacity, then a factory discussion of the actual route.
paragraphs.zh: 泵送单元产生压力，把拌合物推过管道或软管。各品锦型号上的水平输送距离与垂直输送高度是目录最大值，不是对每一种管路布置的保证。管路长、扬程高或弯头多时，应先选目录能力足够的型号，再与工厂讨论实际走向。

bullets.zh: 高产量/长距离：重点看 HBT80-18-140 与 LL60-75。

description.en: Read catalogue conveying distance and height the way a project buyer should, using Pinjin’s published maximum listed figures.

heading.en: Read the catalogue figures as listed maxima

paragraphs.en: Horizontal conveying distance and vertical conveying height on a product page are catalogue parameters, not a guarantee for every pipeline layout. Site pipe diameter, number of bends, mix design and aggregate size all reduce practical reach.
paragraphs.zh: 产品页上的水平输送距离与垂直输送高度是目录参数，不是对每一种管路布置的保证。管径、弯头数量、配合比与骨料粒径都会降低实际可达距离。

paragraphs.en: Pinjin’s homepage performance block states the highest parameters listed in the current catalogue: 600 m horizontal, 300 m vertical, 40–75 m³/h theoretical delivery range and 6 cm largest listed aggregate diameter. Individual models are lower; always open the model specification table.
paragraphs.zh: 品锦首页性能区块写明当前目录列出的最高参数：水平 600 m、垂直 300 m、理论输送量 40–75 m³/h、最大骨料粒径 6 cm。具体型号更低，务必打开该型号参数表。

heading.en: How buyers should specify the job

paragraphs.en: When you request a quote, write the one-way pipeline length, the height difference, the target output and the aggregate size. That is enough for the manufacturer to map the job onto HBT / LL / HBTT models without inventing undocumented performance.
paragraphs.zh: 询价时请写明单程管长、高差、目标产量与骨料粒径。厂家即可把工况对应到 HBT / LL / HBTT 型号，而不会编造未公开性能。

bullets.en: Long horizontal lines: compare HBT80-18-140 and LL60-75 tables.
bullets.zh: 较长水平管路：对照 HBT80-18-140 与 LL60-75 参数表。

bullets.en: Need help mapping scenarios: use the Product Selection Guide.
bullets.zh: 需要按场景对照：使用产品选型指南。

paragraphs.en: Technical articles should lead to a product page, then to an inquiry. Open a related model below, confirm specifications, and send quantity plus pipeline data through the quotation form.
paragraphs.zh: 技术文章应引导到产品页再进入询盘。打开下方相关型号核对参数，再通过询价表提交数量与管路数据。

title.en: Mortar Spraying Machine Buying Guide for Finishing Work
title.zh: 砂浆喷涂机采购指南（饰面与喷浆）

description.en: How contractors shortlist mortar, plaster and concrete spraying machines from a China manufacturer using published application scenarios.
description.zh: 承包商如何按公开应用场景，从中国厂家初选砂浆、石膏与混凝土喷涂机。

heading.en: Match the machine to the material

paragraphs.en: Spraying equipment on this site covers mortar spraying, plaster spraying and concrete spraying. The wrong family wastes labour: a mortar screw sprayer is not a substitute for a dedicated plaster line, and concrete spraying machines are listed for different site duties.
paragraphs.zh: 本站喷涂设备覆盖砂浆喷涂、石膏喷涂与混凝土喷浆。选错系列会浪费人工：砂浆螺旋喷涂机不能替代石膏喷涂线，混凝土喷涂机对应的是另一类工况。

paragraphs.en: Use the spraying-machine category page, then open the model that names your material. Diesel screw mortar spraying machines suit sites without convenient power. Type 311 / Type 511 and plunger spraying machines are listed for other spraying duties. Fully automatic plaster spraying machines target plaster finishing.
paragraphs.zh: 先打开喷涂设备分类，再进入与材料名称对应的型号。柴油螺旋砂浆喷涂机适合用电不便的现场；311 / 511 与柱塞喷涂机对应其他喷浆任务；全自动石膏喷涂机面向石膏饰面。

bullets.en: Mortar / rendering: diesel screw mortar spraying machine.
bullets.zh: 砂浆/抹灰：柴油螺旋砂浆喷涂机。

bullets.en: Plaster finishing: fully automatic plaster spraying machine.
bullets.zh: 石膏饰面：全自动石膏喷涂机。

bullets.en: Concrete spraying: concrete spraying machine page.
bullets.zh: 混凝土喷浆：混凝土喷涂机页面。

heading.en: What to put in the inquiry

paragraphs.en: Tell the factory the material (mortar, plaster or concrete), expected output, power type and whether the job is interior finishing or outdoor spraying. Request a catalogue for the shortlisted model if you need a datasheet before issuing a purchase request.
paragraphs.zh: 请告知材料（砂浆、石膏或混凝土）、预期产量、动力形式，以及室内饰面还是室外喷浆。若下单前需要参数表，可在询盘中索取对应型号目录。

title.en: Diesel vs Electric Concrete Pump: Which Power Type Fits the Site
title.zh: 柴油混凝土泵还是电机混凝土泵：如何按现场选择

description.en: Compare diesel and electric transfer pumps using catalogue models from Hebei Pinjin Machinery for construction sites with or without grid power.
description.zh: 结合河北品锦机械目录型号，比较有电与无电工地的柴油/电机输送泵选择。

paragraphs.en: A concrete pump is only usable if the site can feed it. Diesel units run where grid power is weak or not yet connected. Electric (motor) units suit workshops or sites with stable industrial power, often 380 V as listed on several Pinjin models.
paragraphs.zh: 现场能否供电决定泵能不能用。柴油机适合电网弱或尚未通电的工地；电机型适合车间或有稳定工业用电（目录中多款为 380 V）的现场。

paragraphs.en: Pinjin’s diesel transfer pumps, such as Diesel 4100 and LL15 diesel, are listed for construction sites that need mobility and independent power. They are a practical match for remote pours and early-stage civil works.
paragraphs.zh: 品锦的柴油输送泵（如 Diesel 4100、LL15 柴油版）面向需要机动性与独立动力的工地，适合偏远浇筑与前期土建。

bullets.en: Choose diesel when temporary power is unreliable.
bullets.zh: 临时用电不稳定时优先柴油。

bullets.en: Include fuel logistics and noise limits in the project plan.
bullets.zh: 项目计划中需考虑燃油补给与噪声限制。

paragraphs.en: The LL15 motor version is listed for sites that already have electrical supply. Motor pumps avoid on-site diesel handling and are often preferred for indoor or urban jobs where exhaust is restricted.
paragraphs.zh: LL15 电机版面向已具备供电的现场。电机泵无需现场处理柴油，在室内或限制尾气的城区工程中更常见。

paragraphs.en: If you are unsure, send both the available voltage and the required conveying distance in the inquiry form. The factory can point to the matching catalogue model without guessing undocumented options.
paragraphs.zh: 若不确定，请在询盘中同时写明可用电压与所需输送距离。工厂可按目录对应型号回复，不臆造未公开配置。

title.en: How to Choose a Concrete Pump for a Construction Project
title.zh: 如何为工程项目选择混凝土泵

description.en: Match delivery capacity, conveying distance, power type and aggregate size to catalogue models from a China concrete pump manufacturer.
description.zh: 按输送量、输送距离、动力形式与骨料粒径，对照中国混凝土泵厂家目录选型。

heading.en: Start with the job, not the model name

paragraphs.en: Buyers searching for a concrete pump manufacturer in China often compare model names first. A more reliable path is to list site conditions, then match published catalogue parameters: theoretical delivery capacity, horizontal conveying distance, vertical conveying height and maximum aggregate diameter.
paragraphs.zh: 采购方常先比较型号名称。更稳妥的做法是先列出工况，再对照目录中的理论输送量、水平输送距离、垂直输送高度与最大骨料粒径。

paragraphs.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes these figures for transfer pumps and concrete pumps built in Xingtai, Hebei. Use the figures as a shortlist filter, then request a quotation with your pour rate and pipeline layout.
paragraphs.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台生产输送泵与混凝土泵，并公开上述参数。用参数做初选后，再带浇筑量与管路布置询价。

paragraphs.en: If the project needs high theoretical output and long pipelines, start with larger catalogue pumps. Pinjin’s listed range includes models up to 40–75 m³/h theoretical delivery, 600 m maximum listed horizontal conveying distance and 300 m maximum listed vertical conveying height.
paragraphs.zh: 若项目需要较高理论产量和较长管路，从目录中的大型号入手。品锦目录中的最高理论输送量区间为 40–75 m³/h，列出的最大水平输送距离 600 m、最大垂直输送高度 300 m。

bullets.en: High output / long distance: review HBT80-18-140 and LL60-75.
bullets.zh: 高产量/长距离：重点看 HBT80-18-140 与 LL60-75。

bullets.en: Medium site pours: HBT45-40, HBTT55-50 or HBT30-37.
bullets.zh: 中等现场浇筑：HBT45-40、HBTT55-50 或 HBT30-37。

bullets.en: Compact secondary-structure work: smaller transfer pumps such as LL28-32.
bullets.zh: 紧凑的二次结构施工：可看 LL28-32 等小型输送泵。

paragraphs.en: Diesel and electric (motor) versions exist in the transfer-pump range. Confirm whether the site has stable 380 V supply or needs a diesel unit. Where the catalogue marks customization, share pipeline diameter, rated head or mounting needs with the factory.
paragraphs.zh: 输送泵系列包含柴油与电机版本。确认现场是稳定 380 V 供电还是需要柴油机。目录标明可定制的项目，请把管径、扬程或安装需求发给工厂。

paragraphs.en: Next step: open the Product Selection Guide for scenario matching, then send an inquiry with capacity, distance and aggregate size.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步：打开选型指南对照场景，再把输送量、距离与骨料粒径写入询盘。

question.en: What is a concrete pump used for?
question.zh: 混凝土泵（输送泵）是做什么的？

answer.en: A concrete pump is construction equipment designed to transport liquid concrete through pipelines to hard-to-reach placement areas. Instead of relying only on manual handling or crane buckets, contractors use pumps for faster and more continuous pouring. Hebei Pinjin Machinery manufactures concrete delivery pumps and related construction machinery for building and infrastructure work. Pinjin models cover compact transfer pumps and higher-capacity units, so buyers can match delivery capacity, aggregate size and conveying distance to the job site.
answer.zh: 混凝土泵用于通过管道将混凝土输送到人工或吊斗不易到达的浇筑点，提高施工连续性与效率。河北品锦机械制造混凝土输送泵及相关工程机械，型号覆盖紧凑型输送泵与更大产能机型，采购方可按输送量、骨料粒径与输送距离匹配工况。

question.en: Who is Hebei Pinjin Machinery?
question.zh: 河北品锦机械是一家什么样的公司？

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a construction machinery manufacturer focused on special equipment. The company is located in Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai City, Hebei Province, China. Its positioning is a professional source manufacturer of delivery pumps. Core activities include R&D, production and sales of construction machinery such as concrete pumps, with additional mortar spraying and plaster spraying equipment in the product range.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械制造有限公司是专注特种设备制造的工程机械企业，位于河北省邢台市任泽工业园区，定位为专业输送泵生产源头厂家。主营混凝土泵等工程机械的研发、生产与销售，产品线还包括砂浆喷涂机与石膏喷涂机。

question.en: What products does Pinjin manufacture?
question.zh: 品锦主要生产哪些产品？

answer.en: Pinjin manufactures three main equipment groups: concrete pumps / transfer pumps, mortar spraying machines, and plaster spraying machines. Concrete pump models include Diesel 4100, LL15 diesel/motor versions, ZS22-25, LL28-32, HBT30-37, HBT45-40, HBTT55-50, LL60-75 and HBT80-18-140. The mortar line includes a diesel screw mortar spraying machine. The plaster line includes a fully automatic plaster spraying machine.
answer.zh: 品锦产品主要包括三类：混凝土泵/输送泵、砂浆喷涂机、石膏喷涂机。混凝土泵型号含 Diesel 4100、LL15 柴油/电机版、ZS22-25、LL28-32、HBT30-37、HBT45-40、HBTT55-50、LL60-75、HBT80-18-140；砂浆类有柴油螺杆砂浆喷涂机；石膏类有全自动石膏喷涂机。

question.en: How to choose a concrete pump for a construction project?
question.zh: 施工项目如何选择混凝土泵？

answer.en: Start with four catalogue parameters: theoretical delivery capacity, horizontal conveying distance, vertical conveying height, and max aggregate diameter. Then check power type (diesel or motor), machine dimensions and weight for site access. For smaller jobs, LL15 or Diesel 4100 class pumps may fit. For longer reach and higher output, compare HBT30-37, HBT45-40, HBTT55-50, LL60-75 and HBT80-18-140. Share your pour volume, pipe layout and aggregate size with Pinjin so the team can recommend a suitable model from published specs.
answer.zh: 优先对照四类目录参数：理论输送量、水平输送距离、垂直输送高度、最大骨料粒径；再确认动力形式（柴油/电机）、外形尺寸与整机重量是否便于进场。小型工况可看 LL15、Diesel 4100 一类；更长距离与更高产量可对比 HBT30-37、HBT45-40、HBTT55-50、LL60-75、HBT80-18-140。把浇筑量、管路布置与骨料粒径发给品锦，可按公开参数推荐型号。

question.en: What is the maximum horizontal conveying distance of Pinjin concrete pumps?
question.zh: 品锦混凝土泵最大水平输送距离是多少？

answer.en: In the current product catalogue, the highest listed horizontal conveying distance is 600 m on the HBT80-18-140 concrete pump. Other models list shorter ranges according to their design, for example LL15 diesel at 50 m, LL28-32 at 100 m, HBT30-37 at 250 m, and HBT45-40 at 300 m. Always select by the specific model page rather than assuming one distance for the whole range.
answer.zh: 当前产品目录中，列出的最大水平输送距离为 HBT80-18-140 的 600 m。其他型号按设计不同，例如 LL15 柴油版 50 m、LL28-32 为 100 m、HBT30-37 为 250 m、HBT45-40 为 300 m。请以具体型号页面参数为准，不要把单一距离套用到全系列。

question.en: What vertical conveying height can Pinjin pumps reach?
question.zh: 品锦泵的垂直输送高度能到多少？

answer.en: The highest listed vertical conveying height in the catalogue is 300 m for HBT80-18-140. Mid and large models such as HBT30-37 list 120 m, while HBT45-40 lists 150 m and HBTT55-50 / LL60-75 list 150–180 m. Compact transfer pumps are lower, for example LL15 motor version at 15 m and Diesel 4100 at 25 m. Match vertical height to building floors or placement elevation before ordering.
answer.zh: 目录中最高列出的垂直输送高度为 HBT80-18-140 的 300 m。中大型如 HBT30-37 为 120 m，HBT45-40 为 150 m，HBTT55-50 / LL60-75 为 150–180 m；紧凑型更低，如 LL15 电机版 15 m、Diesel 4100 为 25 m。下单前请按楼层或浇筑高度匹配型号。

question.en: Should I choose a diesel or motor concrete pump?
question.zh: 应该选柴油泵还是电机泵？

answer.en: Choose by site power availability and mobility. Diesel units suit remote or power-limited sites; for example LL15 diesel lists 28 HP diesel engine power. Motor versions suit stable industrial power supply; LL15 motor lists 15 kW motor power and 380 V rated voltage. Many larger Pinjin pumps are diesel-engine based (models such as 4100/4105/4108/6105/6110 listed in the catalogue). Confirm local fuel and electricity conditions before selection.
answer.zh: 按现场供电与机动性选择。柴油机适合偏远或供电不便工地，如 LL15 柴油版目录列出 28 HP；电机版适合稳定工业用电，LL15 电机版列出 15 kW、额定电压 380 V。多数中大型品锦泵为柴油动力（目录含 4100/4105/4108/6105/6110 等机型标注）。请结合燃油与供电条件选型。

question.en: Which Pinjin models suit small concrete pumping jobs?
question.zh: 哪些品锦型号适合小型混凝土输送工况？

answer.en: For compact transfer needs, start with Diesel 4100 (delivery capacity 6–8 m³/h, horizontal 60 m, vertical 25 m), LL15 diesel (5–8 m³/h, horizontal 50 m, vertical 20 m) and LL15 motor (5–8 m³/h, horizontal 30 m, vertical 15 m). ZS22-25 is another practical option with 7–8 m³/h capacity and 60 m horizontal distance. These models are lighter than the large HBT/LL high-capacity pumps and easier to position on constrained sites.
answer.zh: 紧凑输送可优先看 Diesel 4100（输送量 6–8 m³/h，水平 60 m，垂直 25 m）、LL15 柴油版（5–8 m³/h，水平 50 m，垂直 20 m）与 LL15 电机版（5–8 m³/h，水平 30 m，垂直 15 m）。ZS22-25 也较实用（7–8 m³/h，水平 60 m）。相对大型 HBT/LL 机型更轻便，适合场地受限工况。

question.en: What is special about the HBT80-18-140 concrete pump?
question.zh: HBT80-18-140 混凝土泵有什么特点？

answer.en: HBT80-18-140 is positioned for long-distance and high-rise conveying among currently listed Pinjin pumps. Key parameters include theoretical delivery capacity 40–75 m³/h, horizontal conveying distance 600 m, vertical conveying height 300 m, max aggregate diameter 6 cm, and a 6-cylinder / 216 kW diesel engine.
answer.zh: 在当前目录机型中，HBT80-18-140 面向长距离与高扬程输送。主要参数包括理论输送量 40–75 m³/h、水平输送距离 600 m、垂直输送高度 300 m、最大骨料粒径 6 cm，以及六缸 / 216 kW 柴油机参数。

question.en: Do you manufacture mortar spraying machines?
question.zh: 你们是否生产砂浆喷涂机？

answer.en: Yes. Pinjin lists a Diesel Screw Mortar Spraying Machine. Catalogue parameters include power output 15–18 HP, conveying height up to 40 m (depends on materials), horizontal conveying distance up to 60 m (depends on materials), max conveying particle ≤10 mm, spraying pressure 6 MPa, hopper volume 70 L, and machine weight 180 kg. The same product page explicitly states that customization is supported.
answer.zh: 是的。目录含柴油螺杆砂浆喷涂机，参数包括动力输出 15–18 HP、输送高度可达 40 m（根据物料适配）、水平输送距离可达 60 m（根据物料适配）、输送颗粒粒径 ≤10 mm、喷涂压力 6 MPa、料斗容积 70 L、设备重量 180 kg，并明确支持设备定制。

question.en: What plaster spraying equipment do you offer?
question.zh: 你们有哪些石膏喷涂设备？

answer.en: Pinjin offers a Fully Automatic Plaster Spraying Machine. Listed specifications include mixer capacity 115 L, power supply 380 V / 50 Hz, main motor power 5 kW, horizontal conveying distance 20 m, vertical conveying height 10 m, max particle size 6 mm, and air compressor power 3 kW. It is intended for plaster spraying finishing work rather than long-distance concrete pumping.
answer.zh: 品锦提供全自动石膏喷涂机。目录参数包括搅拌容积 115 L、供电 380 V / 50 Hz、主电机功率 5 kW、水平输送距离 20 m、垂直输送高度 10 m、最大颗粒粒径 6 mm、空压机功率 3 kW，面向石膏喷涂饰面施工，而非长距离混凝土泵送。

question.en: Do you support customized concrete pumps or spraying machines?
question.zh: 是否支持混凝土泵或喷涂机定制？

answer.en: Customization is confirmed in the product catalogue for the Diesel Screw Mortar Spraying Machine (“Support customization”). For other models, buyers can send project requirements—capacity, conveying distance, power type and site constraints—and Pinjin can discuss whether a listed configuration fits or what adjustment is feasible.
answer.zh: 产品目录明确柴油螺杆砂浆喷涂机“支持设备定制”。其他型号欢迎提供产能、输送距离、动力形式与场地限制等需求，品锦可基于现有机型讨论适配或可行调整。

question.en: Can I get a concrete pump price from your China manufacturer?
question.zh: 如何向厂家询价混凝土泵价格？

answer.en: Pinjin does not publish fixed online prices because configuration depends on model, options and shipping terms. To request a quote, send the required model or duty parameters (delivery capacity, horizontal/vertical distance, aggregate size, diesel or motor) by WhatsApp or email. The team will respond with a suitable equipment recommendation.
answer.zh: 品锦不在网站公布固定价格，因为配置取决于型号、选配与贸易条款。询价时请通过 WhatsApp 或邮件说明型号或工况参数（输送量、水平/垂直距离、骨料粒径、柴油/电机），我们将回复合适设备方案。

answer.en: Pinjin is located in Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai City, Hebei Province, China. Located in Xingtai, Hebei, Xingjiawan is known as an important manufacturing area for concrete machinery. Overseas buyers can request quotations by WhatsApp or email with project needs and preferred models.

question.en: What aggregate size can Pinjin concrete pumps handle?
question.zh: 品锦混凝土泵可输送多大骨料？

answer.en: Max aggregate diameter depends on the model. Catalogue examples include 0.5–3 cm on Diesel 4100 and ZS22-25, 2 cm on LL15 and LL28-32, 3 cm on HBT30-37 and HBT45-40, 4 cm on HBTT55-50, 5 cm on LL60-75, and 6 cm on HBT80-18-140. Choosing a pump with insufficient aggregate allowance can cause pipe blockage, so always verify this parameter against your concrete mix.
answer.zh: 最大骨料粒径因型号而异。目录示例：Diesel 4100 与 ZS22-25 为 0.5–3 cm，LL15 与 LL28-32 为 2 cm，HBT30-37 与 HBT45-40 为 3 cm，HBTT55-50 为 4 cm，LL60-75 为 5 cm，HBT80-18-140 为 6 cm。骨料允许值不足易堵管，请务必对照配合比核对该参数。

title.en: Raw materials
title.zh: 原材料

body.en: Incoming materials are selected to match catalogue specifications before production starts.
body.zh: 生产前按目录参数要求组织原材料采购与准备。

title.en: Machining
title.zh: 机加工

body.en: Parts are machined with the production equipment described in the company profile.
body.zh: 使用企业简介所述生产设备进行零部件加工。

title.en: Assembly
title.zh: 装配

body.en: Equipment is assembled as a source manufacturer covering R&D, production and sales.
body.zh: 作为集研发、生产与销售一体的源头厂家完成整机装配。

title.en: Quality inspection
title.zh: 质量检测

body.en: A complete testing system supports full-process quality control before delivery.
body.zh: 完善检测体系支撑出厂前的全流程质量管控。

title.en: Factory packing
title.zh: 出厂包装

body.en: Finished equipment is packed at the factory in Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 成品在河北省邢台市任泽工业园区工厂完成包装。

whyFactoryPoints.en: Direct source manufacturer of delivery pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
whyFactoryPoints.zh: 位于河北邢台的输送泵源头生产厂家。

whyFactoryPoints.en: Full-process quality control from incoming materials to finished equipment.
whyFactoryPoints.zh: 从原材料到成品的全流程质量管控。

whyFactoryPoints.en: Equipment customization is supported where listed in the product catalogue.
whyFactoryPoints.zh: 产品目录标明的型号支持按项目需求定制。

whyFactoryPoints.en: Manufacturing base in Renze Industrial Park with published capacity parameters.
whyFactoryPoints.zh: 制造基地位于任泽工业园区，产能与输送参数均来自公开目录。

question.en: Need high-rise or long-distance concrete conveying?
question.zh: 需要高层或长距离混凝土输送？

recommendation.en: Start with HBT80-18-140, then compare LL60-75 / HBTT55-50 / HBT45-40 by capacity and distance.
recommendation.zh: 优先对照 HBT80-18-140，再按输送量与距离比较 LL60-75 / HBTT55-50 / HBT45-40。

rationale.en: Catalogue peak values: HBT80 lists 600 m horizontal / 300 m vertical / 40–75 m³/h.
rationale.zh: 目录峰值：HBT80 列出水平 600 m / 垂直 300 m / 理论输送量 40–75 m³/h。

question.en: Need a pump for medium building projects?
question.zh: 中型建筑项目如何选泵？

recommendation.en: Compare HBT30-37 and HBT45-40 against your pipeline length and vertical height.
recommendation.zh: 按管路长度与垂直高度对照 HBT30-37 与 HBT45-40。

rationale.en: HBT30-37 lists 250 m / 120 m; HBT45-40 lists 300 m / 150 m; LL28-32 lists 100 m / 60 m.

question.en: Need a compact pump for small building sites?
question.zh: 小型工地如何选紧凑型泵？

recommendation.zh: 优先对照柴油4100、LL15（柴油/电机）或 ZS22-25。

rationale.en: These models list shorter conveying distances and lower machine weights in the catalogue.
rationale.zh: 上述型号在目录中水平/垂直距离与机重相对更紧凑。

question.en: Diesel or electric transfer pump?
question.zh: 选柴油版还是电机版输送泵？

recommendation.en: No stable electricity → LL15 Diesel. Stable 380 V → LL15 Motor Version.
recommendation.zh: 供电不便 → LL15 柴油版；稳定 380 V → LL15 电机版。

rationale.en: Catalogue lists 28 HP diesel vs 15 kW / 380 V motor for the LL15 series.
rationale.zh: 目录中 LL15 系列分别标注 28 HP 柴油与 15 kW / 380 V 电机。

question.en: Need mortar spraying?
question.zh: 需要砂浆喷涂？

recommendation.en: Choose Diesel Screw Mortar Spraying Machine (customization supported).
recommendation.zh: 选择柴油螺杆砂浆喷涂机（目录支持定制）。

rationale.en: Catalogue lists 6 MPa spraying pressure, 70 L hopper and customization support.
rationale.zh: 目录列出喷涂压力 6 MPa、料斗 70 L，并支持定制。

question.en: Need plaster spraying for interior finishing?
question.zh: 室内石膏喷涂如何选型？

recommendation.en: Choose Fully Automatic Plaster Spraying Machine.
recommendation.zh: 选择全自动石膏喷涂机。

rationale.en: Catalogue lists 115 L mixer capacity and 380 V / 50 Hz supply with 20 m / 10 m conveying limits.
rationale.zh: 目录列出搅拌容积 115 L、供电 380 V / 50 Hz，输送限值水平 20 m / 垂直 10 m。

question.en: Which spraying machine series fits longer distance?
question.zh: 喷涂机系列如何按距离选型？

recommendation.en: Type 311 (20 m) → Type 511 (40 m) → Double Cylinder Plunger (100 m). For concrete spraying, see Concrete Spraying Machine.
recommendation.zh: 311型（20 m）→ 511型（40 m）→ 双缸柱塞式（100 m）；混凝土喷浆见混凝土喷浆机。

rationale.en: Distances above are conveying distances published in the catalogue for each model.
rationale.zh: 以上距离均为各型号目录公布的输送距离。

question.en: Need material feeding or site handling?
question.zh: 需要给料或现场搬运？

recommendation.en: Spiral feeder for feeding; clamp/bucket forklift loaders for handling.
recommendation.zh: 给料选螺旋给料机；搬运选夹抱式/铲斗式四驱叉车装载机。

rationale.en: Feeder lists customizable head; loaders list lift/unload heights and 4WD drive.
rationale.zh: 给料机目录扬程可定制；装载机列出举升/卸载高度与四驱。

question.en: Need a compact pump for secondary structure pouring?
question.zh: 二次结构浇筑需要紧凑型泵送设备？

recommendation.en: Choose 13 Spiral Feeder (screw pump): 3–6 m³/h, 4 kW, 90 kg mobile unit for secondary structure pouring.
recommendation.zh: 选择13型螺旋泵：额定流量3–6 m³/h、功率4 kW、重量90 kg，定位二次结构浇筑专家。

rationale.en: Published as a secondary structure pouring specialist with customizable rated head.
rationale.zh: 公开定位为二次结构浇筑专家，额定扬程可定制。

question.en: Need automatic stirrup / rebar bending?
question.zh: 需要自动弯箍 / 钢筋弯曲？

recommendation.en: Choose Fully Automatic CNC Steel Bar Bending Machine.
recommendation.zh: 选择全自动数控钢筋弯箍机。

rationale.en: Catalogue publishes single/double strand diameter ranges and CNC speed parameters.
rationale.zh: 目录公布单/双股加工直径范围与数控速度参数。
